note: BUGS.md #290j, 2026-10-17: the 1925 ferry Klamath's two steel propellers on a frame, at the historical marker's coordinates (hmdb 117351). A stand-in; TRIPO.md row for the real model.

name: Scoma's
note: BUGS.md #290m, 2026-10-17: the white board seafood house on Pier 47, a ribbon of windows on the water, SCOMA'S in red over the door and on the roof (Commons 'Boats moored at Fisherman's Wharf, San Francisco 11').

name: Alioto's No. 8
note: BUGS.md #290m, 2026-10-17: the corner of Jefferson and Taylor — dark red-brown, the turquoise 8 and ALIOTO'S, the roof board facing the lagoon, the awnings of Alioto's Waterside Cafe and Crab Stand, Sabella & La Torre, Nick's Lighthouse (Commons 'Fisherman's Wharf, San Francisco, CA, USA - panoramio (125)', 'Boats moored at fisherman's wharf... against the backdrop of Alioto's').

name: The Chowder Hut
note: BUGS.md #290m, 2026-10-17: the octagonal pavilion at Taylor & Jefferson — dark panels and glass, standing-seam roof and lantern, blue menu awnings all round (Commons 'Fisherman's Wharf, San Francisco, CA, USA - panoramio (125)').

name: The Buena Vista
note: BUGS.md #290m, 2026-10-17: the Irish-coffee bar at Hyde & Beach by the cable-car turnaround — sage Edwardian bays, red and blue neon along the bar, the 'the buena vista' neon script sign on the corner (Commons 'Buena Vista Cafe, exterior, San Francisco (May 2025) 01, 03').

name: South End Rowing Club
note: BUGS.md #290m, 2026-10-17: the club's white clapboard boathouse beside the Dolphin Club on Aquatic Park's beach — blue trim, cupola, balcony, 'Since 1877' (Commons 'Dolphin Club and South End Rowing Club 20170906-8513').

name: Longshoremen's Hall (ILWU)
note: BUGS.md #290m, 2026-10-17: the 1959 hexagonal hall — bronze standing-seam tent with zigzag battens on a buff concrete base, raking corner buttresses, the canopy on North Point (Commons 'Longshoremen's Hall, San Francisco (July 2020) -1, -5').
